avis.texte: This cleansing balm works quickly and disolves all my eye makeup and foundation. Deep cleans without drying my sensitive skin out and leaves clean and nourished skin behind. No grime or residue. All the comments about it smelling bad...it smells like unscented oil. If you have used any other natural and unscented oil products it just smells like that. No essential oils to make it scented. This is a fabulous pro for sensitive skin! Great cleanser! I highly recommend trying a cleansing balm if you haven't...skincare game changer!

I struggle with really bad sensitive skin (eczema under eyes plus allergic to a lot of makeups) and this makes sure when i wear makeup all of it is gone! I feel really clean after i use it. Im almost out of my first container that im buying another one! There is a "smell" to it but i do not think it smells bad nor do i really notice since i usually just wash it off within a few minutes. The next day waking up my skin usually feels super clean and looks great! I 10/10 recommend!!!
You don't need to wash more than once to make sure the makeup is off.
Its ok, does a good job getting makeup off. but I am struggling with the smell. It smells like old cardboard boxes.

I'm a big believer of cleansing balms; I use them as my first step to remove makeup, then proceed to cleansing. I have found there is no need to buy a designer, more expensive brand, honestly, they all work. But I do NOT recommend this particular brand...why? The smell! It's completely offensive, it reminds of gasoline or a auto repair shop. It works well enough, but the fragrance is so off-putting, that after just a few uses, I threw the whole thing away. Waste of money in my opinion. Blech!

I personally like this cleansing balm, it does a great job with taking off all of my makeup and it works great on sensitive skin. It does have the slightest "fragance" to it but I never really noticed it until I read some of the other reviews. Also, I do want to point out that it doesn't take off mascara as quickly unlike some of the other balms I've tried, I have to stand there rubbing my eyes for a good minute for it to come off—hence, why I'm only giving it 4 stars.

I seriously don't understand the negative comments with this one. I bought this at my local ulta on clearence (6$!!) without reading any reviews and it seriously is a game changer for makeup remover. It took off my makeup effortlessly, even eyelash glue. It didnt make my face feel oily afterwards, it felt smooth without being tight, dry or oily. I rubbed it into my eye makeup as well and no irritation. It seems super gentle and didn't aggravate my piercings either. It doesnt really smell like anything imo, just like a balm ig?? The closest thing i could compare it to is like a mild vaseline smell but nothing crazy, doesnt smell like chemicals or fragrance. HIGHLY RECCOMENDED! This seems like such a slept on K-Beauty brand and i would love to try their other skincare.
I loved this product, it left my skin smooth after using it and it took off my waterproof mascara and lash glue. I didnt smell anything chemical about it or any odor.

avis.titre: The worst cleansing balm I've ever used
avis.texte: I bought three cleansing balms at the same time. This one is the worst. The oil stays on my face even after rinsing with water, and I have to use my regular face cleanser three times to remove the balm's oil. I'm not picky about the smell, but this one smells like expired oil, which I don't like. I wish I could return it.
It did get my make off well but the odor is just too much. I purchased this to try because of the good price point and clean ingredients but have stopped using it due to the smell.

It is not good to put anywhere near your eyes. It will start burning. Usually that never happens to me. If you mix water with it, it won't emulsify and it'll take even longer to mix into your face to get rid of make up. It has a weird like chemical smell to it. Again would not recomend.

Purchased this because it is claiming that it is formulated without fragrance. Not sure what they consider fragrance but it definitely has a strong chemical odor. I tried it on my face and immediately smelled the strong odor and removed it, so not sure how well it works. Based on the odor, I definitely would not put the product with chemical smell on my skin. Returning product.

Love this cleansing balm. It deeps cleans without stripping and leaves your skin moisturized and soft afterwards. I haven't smelled any scent with this product. The only thing is dont like is when i used it to take off waterproof mascara and eyeliner it burned bad, so i will just use to take off makeup on my face instead. Overall love this product.

I purchased this because it was under the 'Fragrance Free' filter, but I noticed a strong floral fragrance when I used it. It in fact does have 'fragranve' listed as an ingredient, so im not surr why it was listed as a fragrsnce free product. It also isnt as moisturizing and emulsifying as other balms I've tried. Unfortunately I'll have to return it.

I love this cleansing balm. I was using another popular one (green container) and found it to be too gritty for my sensitive skin. I have rosacea and this doesn't irritate my skin AT all. It takes all of my foundation off and leaves my skin feeling soft and smooth. I enjoy the texture and find it doesn't have any strong scent (a huge pro for me). Will definitely keep using!
I have. Dry snetivie skin. I often have eszcema on my cheeks. This product is very gentle on the face. And Removed all the make up and dirt off my face .

So far so good! Make up melts off. I only gave it 4 stars because it takes a lot more "oomph" to get waterproof mascara off. There is a slight fragrance so I wouldnt use if youre sensitive to that. But it works really well and I love it so far!
I decided to give this a try because it said deep cleaning and it did not disappoint. a little goes a long way. it took all my.make up off and left my skin feeling soft.

Ive been using this brand makeup removing balm for a few months now and this balm is awesome. I had been using the big name (blue) brand makeup balm and decided to give this one a try. The size of the jar is larger and you get a good amount of product. I like that it comes with a spoon to remove the balm out. It does a greatvjob of removing all makeup even waterproof. It is scent free and vegan. It is more expensive than the drugstore brand and i did get mine free in exchange for a review on another site but its a great makeup remover and I would buy it again.
